headline: Wetland line review for 75-85 Dodge Hill Road continued after questions from a neighbor.
summary: Members will decide whether to approve the wetland lines marked on the property. No DEP file number had been issued yet, and the item returns December 2nd. Seven other items were approved, including a negative determination for 231 Manchaug Road.
decisions: Approved a negative determination for 231 Manchaug Road, 3-0 with one member recused.
Approved a negative determination for 5 Sunrise Drive, 4-0.
Approved an Order of Resource Area Delineation for 185 Uxbridge Road, 4-0.
Continued the wetland line review for 75-85 Dodge Hill Road to December 2nd, 4-0.
Approved a complete certificate of compliance for 45 Stone School Road, 4-0.
Approved a partial certificate of compliance for 57 Purgatory Road, 4-0.
Ratified the emergency certificate for 154 Putnam Hill Road, 4-0.
Approved a complete certificate of compliance for 58 Putnam Hill Road, 4-0.
discussion: 75-85 Dodge Hill Road wetlands: Public speakers asked about the plan and said the land is very wet. Members said any later building would need a new filing.

231 Manchaug Road garage: The engineer said the garage would extend an existing gravel drive and avoid the 100-foot buffer. The agent said the wetland lines appear accurate and noted possible ATV use in the woods.
5 Sunrise Drive wall: The new wall would keep the same height and location. Members agreed to a letter of substantial completion with pictures, not an as-built.

58 Putnam Hill Road agenda: Members discussed whether a late item could be heard. They agreed it could be taken up as unexpected business because it arrived within 48 hours after the agenda was posted.
72 Main Street enforcement: Members said Douglas is reviewing the restoration plan. The enforcement order would be released if no work in Sutton is needed.
